dvids.title: U.S. Forces Disable Cargo Vessel Attempting to Violate Naval Blockade
dvids.desc: U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman, Nov. 7, after the ship’s civilian crew ignored repeated warnings and attempted to violate the naval blockade against Iran multiple times. (U.S. Central Command Video)

dvids.title: U.S. Forces Disable Cargo Vessel Attempting to Violate Naval Blockade
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman, Nov. 7, after the ship’s civilian crew ignored repeated warnings and attempted to violate the naval blockade against Iran multiple times.

dvids.title: CENTCOM Launches Task Force to Disrupt Iranian Ground Transit Routes Supporting Illegal Shipments
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — On Nov. 7, the commander of U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) directed the establishment of a task force that will support ongoing U.S. government efforts to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport advanced weapons and other materials.
